root_cause: The terminal delivery path had exact production readback for Netlify-hosted runtime, but no equivalent route for Supabase Edge Function source. A protected merge could therefore be correct and production-proven at the provider while Powerhouse Obligation Terminalizer still failed closed with UNWIRED_NON_NETLIFY_RUNTIME_READBACK.
failed_approach: Treating every non-governance runtime change as Netlify-hosted runtime and using release.json as the only runtime identity source cannot prove Supabase Edge Function deployment identity.
fix: Add a side-effect-free runtime_readback mode to affected Edge Functions, bind it to a normalized SHA-256 source fingerprint and DENO_DEPLOYMENT_ID, and route Supabase function paths through that verifier in Production Release Readback and Powerhouse Obligation Terminalizer.
prevention_rule: Every executable production runtime family must have an explicit fail-closed provider readback adapter before a terminal delivery workflow may classify it as LIVE_BEWEZEN; unknown runtime paths remain blocked.
